description: Warm-start incremental update REJECTED — validation gate failed. model_enriched.json remains the active model; no promotion occurred.
honest_context: The 'recent data' used for warm-start fine-tuning is the chronological tail of the TRAINING set (last 20% of training windows by row position) — not genuinely new live data. In production this would be newly labeled transactions from the live stream since the last training run. The warm-start mechanism, validation gate, and promote/reject artifact contract are unaffected by that distinction; this run demonstrates the machinery works end-to-end, not that a real-world update was warranted.
